#  PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught TypeError: abs(): Argument #1 ($num) must be of type int|float, string given

I get this error hundreds of times in the Apache error log:
> Got error 'PHP message: PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught TypeError: abs(): Argument #1 ($num) must be of type int|float, string given in controllers/front/CartController.php:79

It comes from an incoorect URL (I don't know yet why it is called) `https://example.com/panier?add=1&id_product=41261&qty=`.
`panier` certainly is `cart`in an english shop. Notice the missing `qty=` value at the end.

## Attendu
I expect the code to validate parameters, in order to avoid server errors when a wrong URL is called.

## Étapes
1. Navigate in the FO to the page `https://example.com/panier?add=1&id_product=41261&qty=` in a French shop (or `[https://example.com/cart?add=1&id_product=41261&qty=` in an English shop)
2. Look into the apache error log. You will notice an error like above. The error is not visible in `BO/Advanced Parameters/Logs` nor in `var/logs`.
